cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

index_name.description: Optional index name filter; use an empty string to query all indices.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM .monitoring-es-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE metricset.name == "index"
| WHERE elasticsearch.cluster.name IS NOT NULL AND elasticsearch.index.name IS NOT NULL
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| WHERE (?index_name == "" OR elasticsearch.index.name == ?index_name)
| STATS fielddata_memory_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.fielddata.memory_size_in_bytes), fielddata_evictions = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.fielddata.evictions), query_cache_memory_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.query_cache.memory_size_in_bytes), query_cache_evictions = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.query_cache.evictions), request_cache_memory_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.request_cache.memory_size_in_bytes), request_cache_evictions = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.request_cache.evictions), segment_doc_values_memory_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.segments.doc_values_memory_in_bytes), segment_fields_memory_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.segments.memory_in_bytes), segments_count = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.segments.count), docs_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.docs.count) BY elasticsearch.cluster.name, elasticsearch.index.name
| EVAL explosion_score = COALESCE(fielddata_memory_bytes, 0) + COALESCE(segment_doc_values_memory_bytes, 0) + COALESCE(segment_fields_memory_bytes, 0) + COALESCE(fielddata_evictions, 0) * 1000000 + COALESCE(query_cache_evictions, 0) * 1000000 + COALESCE(request_cache_evictions, 0) * 1000000 + COALESCE(segments_count, 0) * 100
| SORT explosion_score DESC
| LIMIT 50

description: Find indices with fielddata, cache, or segment-growth pressure that can indicate mapping explosion.
